steps.title: Analyze Crash on App Open
steps.description: Analyze the entry point of PicBlend Compare to trace potential layout inflation or view initialization crashes during MainActivity onCreate

steps.title: Enforce Robust Resource Decoding in Sandbox View
steps.description: Protect the bitmap loading stage with extensive try-catch blocks capturing any Throwable to guarantee safe start-up even when asset drawables are invalid, empty, or missing in the test environment

steps.title: Introduce Dimension Guarding in Bitmaps
steps.description: Ensure decoded images have valid non-zero dimensions before configuring draw buffers and layouts, fallback-rendering an custom auto-generated placeholder

steps.title: Defensively Create Back-up Placeholders
steps.description: Improve placeholder rendering methods with comprehensive failure traps to prevent rendering cycle failures on older OS configurations

steps.title: Avoid Division-by-Zero and NaN in Drawing Scales
steps.description: Add structural validations for width and height in drawFitImage scaling algorithms to eliminate Infinity or NaN floating-point divisions that crash Canvas rendering loops

steps.title: Recycled Bitmaps Guarding
steps.description: Validate if bitmaps are recycled before executing layout transformations or draw calls, preventing unexpected RuntimeExceptions

steps.title: Secure View References in MainActivity
steps.description: Incorporate defensive null pointer check safety guards across all view lookup nodes and button event registrations in MainActivity

steps.title: Verify Interface Synchronization Callbacks
steps.description: Audit the slider synchronization callbacks to prevent background thread feedback loops when swapping views or setting manual values

steps.title: Review Java 8 Compatibility Constraints
steps.description: Perform validation on Java files to verify the strict use of anonymous inner classes instead of modern lambdas or stream structures

steps.title: Remove External Third-Party Dependencies to Comply with Strict Android Native Rules
steps.description: Completely remove nanohttpd dependency in app/build.gradle to ensure compliance with strict native built-in SDK constraints and resolve target runtime class clashes

steps.title: Clean and Verify Resource Purity
steps.description: Perform validation of drawable resource references and configuration styling elements to prevent InflateException during startup

steps.title: Building PicBlend Compare
steps.description: Verify the build config and compile the modified, crash-resistant version of PicBlend Compare securely
